name: Ryou Seibai! ~Gakuen Bishoujo Seisai Hiroku~
original_name: 凌成敗！～学園美少女制裁秘録～
source: Private Kibitsu Academy is a prestigious high school that attracts talented students from different backgrounds. Despite most of its students are beautiful females, the school has many problems, one of which is the Gakuseikai, an autonomous group that controls the academy. The protagonist, Hinase Kyouichirou, lives a happy life with his sister-in-law and teacher Saki, until she is assaulted by members of the Gakuseikai and falls into a state of mental breakdown. A school nurse Yamiko Shiroyuki approaches Kyouichirou and invites him to become a member of her team of auditors to defeat the Gakuseikai. Frustrated with his own powerlessness, he agrees to join the team and swear to bring justice to the school.
translation: 私立吉备津学园是一所名门高中，汇聚了出身各异的优秀学生。尽管校内大多数学生都是美少女，学园却存在许多问题，其中之一便是控制全校的自治组织“学生会”。主人公日生恭一郎原本与义姐兼教师日生咲过着幸福生活，直到咲遭学生会成员侵犯，精神彻底崩溃。校医白石闇子找到恭一郎，邀请他加入自己的监察小队，共同打倒学生会。恭一郎痛恨自己的无能为力，于是答应加入，并发誓为学园伸张正义。
